# Economic Outcomes of City Climate Policies

```{r}
# Load libraries & datasets
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)

# ACEEE policy score csv
policy_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/clara/OneDrive/Desktop/PLAN 372/Final Project/aceee_city_scorecard_2024_verified.csv")

# View the table
policy_data
```


```{r}
# ACS data
acs_data <- get_acs(
  geography = "place",
  variables = c(
    median_income = "B19013_001",
    poverty_total = "B17001_001",
    poverty_count = "B17001_002",
    labor_force = "B23025_003",
    unemployed = "B23025_005",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
)
```

```{r}
# Clean ACS place names
acs_clean <- acs_data %>%
  separate(NAME, into = c("city_raw", "state_name"), sep = ", ") %>%
  mutate(
    city = city_raw %>%
      str_remove(" city") %>%
      str_remove(" city \\(balance\\)") %>%
      str_remove(" town") %>%
      str_remove(" CDP") %>%
      str_remove(" municipality") %>%
      str_remove(" urban county") %>%
      str_remove(" metropolitan government \\(balance\\)") %>%
      str_remove(" consolidated government \\(balance\\)"),
    state = state.abb[match(state_name, state.name)]
  )
```

```{r}
# Fix name issues from csv
acs_clean <- acs_clean %>%
  mutate(
    city = case_when(
      city == "St. Paul" ~ "Saint Paul",
      city == "San Jose" ~ "San José",
      str_detect(city_raw, "Washington") & state_name == "District of Columbia" ~ "Washington",
      str_detect(city_raw, "Urban Honolulu") ~ "Honolulu",
      str_detect(city_raw, "Nashville-Davidson") ~ "Nashville",
      str_detect(city_raw, "Louisville/Jefferson County") ~ "Louisville",
      TRUE ~ city
    ),
    state = ifelse(state_name == "District of Columbia", "DC", state)
  )
```

```{r}
# 3 economic outcome variables
acs_economic <- acs_clean %>%
  transmute(
    city,
    state,
    median_income = median_incomeE,
    poverty_rate = (poverty_countE / poverty_totalE) * 100,
    unemployment_rate = (unemployedE / labor_forceE) * 100,
    population = populationE
  )
```

```{r}
# Merge ACEEE data with ACS data
final_data <- policy_data %>%
  left_join(acs_economic, by = c("city", "state"))
```

```{r}
# Check how many cities matched
sum(!is.na(final_data$median_income))
nrow(final_data)
```

```{r}
# unmatched cities
final_data %>%
  filter(is.na(median_income)) %>%
  select(city, state)
```

```{r}
# final merged dataset
write.csv(final_data, "final_city_climate_economic_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# stats
summary(final_data)
```

```{r}
# policy score and median income scatterplot
ggplot(final_data, aes(x = policy_score, y = median_income)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Policy Score and Median Household Income",
    x = "ACEEE Climate Policy Score",
    y = "Median Household Income"
  )
```

```{r}
# Policy score and unemployment rate scatterplot
ggplot(final_data, aes(x = policy_score, y = unemployment_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Policy Score and Unemployment Rate",
    x = "ACEEE Climate Policy Score",
    y = "Unemployment Rate (%)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Policy score and poverty rate scatterplot
ggplot(final_data, aes(x = policy_score, y = poverty_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Climate Policy Score and Poverty Rate",
    x = "ACEEE Climate Policy Score",
    y = "Poverty Rate (%)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Regression models
income_model <- lm(median_income ~ policy_score, data = final_data)
unemployment_model <- lm(unemployment_rate ~ policy_score, data = final_data)
poverty_model <- lm(poverty_rate ~ policy_score, data = final_data)

# View
summary(income_model)
```

```{r}
summary(unemployment_model)
```

```{r}
summary(poverty_model)
```
